raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "beam length, height, and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4 give no physical dimensions or length-to-height ratio. Counts of 120 by 60 hexagonal elements do not independently determine these dimensions.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangular domain with L=2 and H=1.",
        "Rectangular domain with L=4 and H=1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 specifies a two-dimensional problem without a thickness or per-unit-thickness convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 in consistent length units.",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "concentrated load at the lower-right corner",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 refers to Fig. 1 for loading. Its caption determines the lower-right corner, but neither prose nor caption supplies the force direction.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward: F=(0,-P).",
        "Horizontally outward: F=(P,0).",
        "Diagonally downward and outward: F=(P/sqrt(2),-P/sqrt(2))."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "concentrated load at the lower-right corner",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1, the Fig. 1 caption, and Sec. 4 give no load magnitude or force normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "P=1 in consistent solver force units.",
        "P=10 in the same force units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "nondesign regions near the support and load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4 do not specify whether any cells are fixed solid or void, including support and load pads, or how fixed-solid volume would be counted.",
      "readings": [
        "Every domain cell is designable; there are no passive regions.",
        "Fix a one-cell-wide strip along the left edge and the load-corner cell solid; include their volume in the whole-domain volume budget.",
        "Use the same fixed-solid cells, but apply the prescribed fraction only to the remaining designable cells."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "single-material volume-fraction limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) introduces V_fm, but no numerical value is supplied for the M=1 extended SIMP result in Sec. 4 or Table 2.",
      "readings": [
        "V_f1=0.3.",
        "V_f1=0.4.",
        "V_f1=0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "density field used to evaluate material volume",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (1) leaves V(x) undefined. Sec. 2.2.1 explicitly sends projected densities into stiffness interpolation, but does not identify the density field used in the volume constraint.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain the volume-weighted mean of raw design variables x_e.",
        "Constrain the volume-weighted mean of filtered variables tilde{x}_e.",
        "Constrain the volume-weighted mean of projected physical variables x_e^phys."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The material descriptions and Sec. 4 provide Young's moduli but no Poisson's ratio for constructing the elastic constitutive matrix.",
      "readings": [
        "Use constant nu=0.3 throughout the domain.",
        "Use constant nu=0.25 throughout the domain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 calls the beam two-dimensional without specifying plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "phase counting, modulus assignment, and void stiffness",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Table 1 gives phase 1 modulus 1 and void modulus 10^-9, while Eq. (14) generates a zero-modulus phase with ascending numbering. It does not explain whether N_MP includes void; using N_MP=1 makes Eq. (14) undefined. Eq. (4) separately requires nonzero void stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow Table 1 and Eq. (4): E_1=1 and E_min=10^-9; interpret Eq. (14)'s zero as nominal void before regularization.",
        "Follow Eq. (14) literally with two phases including void: solid modulus 1 and void modulus 0, with zero-stiffness degrees of freedom handled explicitly."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP penalization exponent",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.0.1 introduces p in Eq. (4), but neither its value nor a continuation policy is given.",
      "readings": [
        "Keep p=3 throughout optimization.",
        "Keep p=4 throughout optimization.",
        "Start at p=1 and increase by 0.5 every 50 iterations until p=3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter weights",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) normalizes weights W_ej but never defines their functional form.",
      "readings": [
        "Cone weights: W_ej=max(0,r-d_ej).",
        "Uniform weights: W_ej=1 for d_ej<r and zero otherwise.",
        "Truncated Gaussian weights: W_ej=exp(-d_ej^2/(2(r/2)^2)) for d_ej<r and zero otherwise."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter distance and neighborhood",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.2.1 says the neighborhood is determined by a radius without specifying the distance metric or how hexagonal neighbors are selected.",
      "readings": [
        "Use Euclidean distance between physical element centroids.",
        "Use Euclidean distance between row and column indices.",
        "Use shortest-path distance on the hexagonal element-adjacency graph."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "physical interpretation of filter radius 4",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies r_fill=4 without units or a conversion from the hexagonal mesh to a structured grid.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius equals four Cartesian cell widths.",
        "Radius equals four original hexagon side lengths.",
        "Radius equals four original nearest-neighbor centroid spacings.",
        "Radius equals 4 in the coordinates used for the domain geometry."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "projection continuation schedule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 fixes beta's initial value at 1 and maximum at 32, but gives no intermediate sequence, update interval, or advancement criterion.",
      "readings": [
        "Double beta through 1,2,4,8,16,32 every 50 iterations.",
        "Double beta through 1,2,4,8,16,32 every 100 iterations.",
        "Double beta whenever the maximum design-variable change falls below 0.01."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No initial density field is specified for the M=1 SIMP optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every raw design variable to V_f1.",
        "Initialize every raw design variable to 0.5.",
        "Initialize every raw design variable to 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA update parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The abstract and introduction name MMA, but do not provide move limits, initial asymptotes, asymptote adaptation factors, or subproblem parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "Use move limit 0.2, initial asymptote distance 0.5, expansion factor 1.2, contraction factor 0.7, and MMA parameters a0=1, a=0, c=1000, d=0.",
        "Use move limit 0.1, initial asymptote distance 0.25, expansion factor 1.05, contraction factor 0.5, and MMA parameters a0=1, a=0, c=10000, d=0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimization termination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 gives no maximum iteration count, convergence tolerance, feasibility tolerance, or final-stage stopping criterion.",
      "readings": [
        "At beta=32, stop when maximum design-variable change is below 10^-3 and volume violation is below 10^-6; cap at 1000 iterations.",
        "At beta=32, stop when relative compliance change stays below 10^-5 for five iterations and volume violation is below 10^-4; cap at 500 iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "hexagonal mesh geometry and boundary construction",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4 supplies HoneyMesher's nominal horizontal and vertical counts, but not element pitch, orientation, staggering, node coordinates, or boundary trimming. The Fig. 1 image is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Flat-top hexagons with staggered columns and complete boundary hexagons.",
        "Pointy-top hexagons with staggered rows and complete boundary hexagons.",
        "A hexagonal interior mesh trimmed to an exact rectangular boundary."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "structured-grid replacement and element formulation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The stated 120-by-60 counts apply to hexagonal FEs. No equivalent Cartesian resolution, element stiffness formulation, or integration rule is prescribed. A structured-grid replacement therefore cannot be assumed numerically identical to the paper's discretization.",
      "readings": [
        "Use 120 by 60 bilinear quadrilateral elements with full 2-by-2 Gauss integration.",
        "Use 240 by 120 bilinear quadrilateral elements with full integration on the same physical domain.",
        "Use 120 by 60 bilinear quadrilateral elements with stabilized reduced integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "equilibrium-solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) states equilibrium, but no numerical solution method or residual tolerance is reported for evaluating compliance and sensitivities.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a sparse direct solve in double precision.",
        "Use an iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 10^-6.",
        "Use an iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 10^-10."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
